story: John Conway – The world’s most charismatic mathematician

story: Oh My Gosh, It’s Covered in Rule 30s
text: I think it is funny, Conway doesn't really enjoy being solely associated with GOL and the fame it brings[0].. In stark contrast with Wolfram's ego. Perhaps this arrangement actually works out best for both of them. [0] [VIDEO]
VSauce tweeted a playlist of Conway's appearances on Numberphile, including that one: [VIDEO] I found the one you posted especially moving, but the others were good too.

> I know Conway was slightly resentful that game of life overshadowed some of his other work in the public's imagination, but I've always been entranced by it. He seems to have come to terms with it.[1] [1] [VIDEO]

story: A Lisp Interpreter Implemented in Conway's Game of Life
